name: Rail tunnel portal (single-arch cornice + shadow banding + brown rail shadow)

anchor.note: dx/dy are tile offsets from the top-left of the footprint; the shadow band forms the dark tunnel mouth, the rail shadow marks track level below it, the cornice caps the opening at the bottom of this sheet band, and a support pillar stands beside the mouth.

offset_basis_summary: Single_Tunnel_Shadow_1, Single_Tunnel_Brown_Rail_Shadow and Single_Tunnel_Cornice all sit in the same contiguous band of the 20_Subway_and_Train_Station sheet (x0-112, y2352-2464), so those three offsets are sheet_relative from a shared origin at the band's true top-left (0,2352) -- note the sheet's vertical sprite order (shadow, then rail-shadow, then cornice) does not necessarily match final on-screen stacking, since sheet rows commonly hold alternate render layers rather than a literal vertical cross-section. Big_Pillar lives in an unrelated sheet region, so its placement beside the tunnel mouth is hand-authored.

pieces.notes: Dark tunnel-mouth overlay; top of the sheet band (origin row).
Track-level shadow strip, 4 tiles below shadow_band on the sheet.
Portal frame / cornice cap spanning the full tunnel width; 5 tiles below shadow_band on the sheet.
Structural column beside the tunnel mouth, matching the pillar role used in grp.subway.station_stairs.

variants.tunnel_width: Swap me.subway.tunnel_single for me.subway.tunnel_double for a two-track portal (double_tunnel_cornice etc. follow the same sheet-relative band, shifted down to y2544+).

notes: Sheet-relative tunnel-portal band (shadow + rail-shadow + cornice all co-located on the sheet) closed off with a hand-placed structural pillar borrowed from the station_stairs vocabulary.
